question: El Nino is a phenomenon in which a warm ocean current that flows past the _______ coast, in place of the cold current, every 2 to 5 years.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Peruvian.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **El Niño is a climate pattern that describes the unusual warming of surface waters in the eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean**.
 
• Trade winds and the atmosphere are also impacted by El Niño. 
 
• El Niño is a climate pattern that describes the unusual warming of surface waters in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean.
 
• **El Nino, meaning "Child Christ'**' is a warm ocean current appearing along the Peru coast, generally in December. 
 
• It normally happens once every 4-5 years though it is not fixed. 
 
• It replaces the cold Peru Ocean current flowing along the Peru coast in normal years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Brazilian and Argentinian coasts **are not directly affected by El Nino, although they may experience some indirect impacts on their weather patterns.
 
• **The Chilean coast is also affected by El Nino**, but the current does not flow past it in place of the cold current. Instead, the warm current moves closer to the coast, leading to warmer sea surface temperatures and changes in the marine ecosystem.
